# cssprobe-cli

> Runtime CSS probe — inspect layout, scroll, colors, backgrounds, fonts in a live browser. Returns DOM tree, ASCII layout diagram and confidence-classified findings for humans and AI agents. Interaction commands (click / hover / type / wait-for) drive the page; `sample` / `wait-stable` capture timeline regressions; `frames` targets iframes; `doctor` diagnoses browser installs; `run <file>` executes scripted multi-step flows with assertions and page-error capture; `scenario run <suite.json>` runs repeatable regression suites with artifacts and JUnit output.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mack-peng/cssprobe-cli/main/README.md): overview, quick start, configuration
- [MCP server usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mack-peng/cssprobe-cli/main/README.md): `cssprobe-cli mcp-install` — native tools for Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / opencode / Gemini / Hermes (10 tools: open, inspect, tree, layout, findings, eval, screenshot, inject_css, close, status)
- [Installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mack-peng/cssprobe-cli/main/docs/guide/installation.md): agent-friendly install and skill wiring (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, …)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cssprobe-cli): `npm install -g cssprobe-cli`

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mack-peng/cssprobe-cli): source code, issues, releases
- [cssgraph](https://github.com/mack-peng/cssgraph): companion static CSS knowledge graph for AI agents
